snippet.title: Kingdom's Return Time Eating Fruit and the Ancient Monster - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Rebuild your Kingdom with Action and Strategy!
"Kingdom's Return: Time-Eating Fruit and the Ancient Monster" releases April 23rd, 2026!

Official website: https://kingdom-return.com/
Steam store: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3882650/

■What is Kingdom's Return: Time-Eating Fruit and the Ancient Monster?
Kingdom's Return is an action RPG where players must adventure to restore their fallen kingdom. Collect materials in 2D side-scrolling adventure stages, then use them in the strategy part to build your city as you see fit, and powering up your characters in the process! 
Choose from one of four characters, Imperial, Alchemist, Wizard, or Zipangu, and set out on adventure through a variety of action stages. Collect the materials here you’ll use to build up your kingdom, placing buildings that buff your characters’ stats. Then set out again to conquer even more dangerous stages, until the bosses are afraid of you!

※The Nintendo Switch version can be upgraded to the Nintendo Switch 2 Edition with a free upgrade pack.

Product Information
Title:
Kingdom’s Return: Time-Eating Fruit and the Ancient Monster

Platforms (Digital):
Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch 2, PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, PC (Steam)

Genre: Action/Strategy
Rating: Pending
Players: 1

Release Date:
April 23rd, 2026

Price:
$14.99
